title: Scenario 3, Task 1: Develop a Simulated Investment Proposal
old_notes: The proposal is substantive and well sourced: it asks the clarifying questions, gives a full allocation with reasons, quantified risks (drawdown, 30% dividend withholding, USD 60,000 estate-tax threshold, FX under the peg) and a rewritten plain-language introduction with a glossary. However, the client's accepted default of keeping ~5% cash was not honoured — the plan holds 10% in SGOV/T-bills throughout, and the team explicitly flagged this as unmet rather than fixing it. That single deviation from an agreed constraint is why it does not pass.
new_notes: The proposal is thorough, sourced, and covers the reasons, risks and a plain-language introduction with a glossary. However, the client accepted the stated defaults, which included keeping ~5% cash, and the delivered plan holds 10% in SGOV/T-bills; the team itself flagged this as unmet. The 10% is argued for, but it deviates from an explicit client-accepted constraint, so the request is not fully met.
